questions.question:
If 8 R 10 S 7 T 12 = 75 and 18 R 6 S 8 T 30 = 86, then

24 R 15 S 9 T 35 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**R means ×, S means +, and T means -**

8 R 10 S 7 T 12 = 75

8 × 10 + 7 - 12 = 80 + 7 - 12 = 75

18 R 6 S 8 T 30 = 86, 

18 × 6 + 8 - 30 = 108 + 8 - 30 = 86

Similarly, 24 R 15 S 9 T 35 = ? 

24 × 15 + 9 - 35 = 360 + 9 - 35 = **334**

Hence, the correct answer is **"334".**

questions.question: Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P is to the immediate neighbour of both Q and R. S is not the immediate neighbour of either R or T. V is immediate neighbour of both T and U. V is second to the right of S. Who is sitting on the immediate right of R?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V.

1) V is second to the right of S.

2) V is immediate neighbour of both T and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a48f1ffd241a6a1625980562019ca3ac21d3b0d089a67e3c00477796f224b297.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b31bb6f52a9af9f9aa4465cb0f3ac2390fcf6d5f4a34211170a2df69bff7d0.png] 

3) P is to the immediate neighbour of both Q and R.

4) S is not the immediate neighbour of either R or T.

**Final arrangement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c07a3c723c815763447eb1cb19ecacfc61c0947f4ec6095588330d6f69f0a998.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc06b4718314c1c2d1302df86ad53dd20e779630b358c06022868b356150ffee.png] 

So, **P** is sitting on the immediate right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs and two numbers (not digits) the expression will be correct?

3 ÷ 1 + 5 × 2 - 6 = -1
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given equation: 3 ÷ 1 + 5 × 2 - 6 = -1 

Option 1) + and ×, 3 and 6

By interchanging which two signs and two numbers:

⇒ __**6 ÷ 1 × 5**__ + 2 - 3 = -1

⇒ __**30 + 2**__ - 3 = -1

⇒ __**32 - 3**__ = -1

⇒ 29 = -1

Option 2) × and +, 6 and 5

By interchanging which two signs and two numbers:

⇒ __**3 ÷ 1 × 6**__ + 2 - 5 = -1

⇒ __**18 + 2**__ - 5 = -1

⇒ __**20 - 5**__ = -1

⇒ 15 = -1

Option 3) × and ÷, 5 and 2

By interchanging which two signs and two numbers:

⇒ 3 × 1 + __**2 ÷ 5**__ - 6 = -1

⇒** 3 + 0.4 - 6** = -1

⇒ -2.6 = -1

**Option 4) + and -, 3 and 6**

By interchanging which two signs and two numbers:

⇒ __**6 ÷ 1**__ - 5 × 2 + 3 = -1

⇒ 6 - __**5 × 2**__ + 3 = -1

⇒ __**6**__ - 10 __**+ 3**__ = -1

⇒ __**9 - 10**__ = -1

**⇒ -1 = -1**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****+ and -, 3 and 6****"**.

questions.question:
If A + B means A is the wife of B, A × B means A is the father of B, A ÷ B means A is the mother of B, A $ B means A is the brother of B and A - B means A is the sister of B.

If Z - T ÷ S × Y + H $ B, then how is S related to H?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife 
 Sister
 Father
 Mother

Given: Z - T ÷ S × Y + H $ B

It means: Z is the sister of T, T is the mother of S, S is the father of Y, Y is the wife of H and H is the brother of B.

So, S is the 'Wife's father' of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "'Wife's father".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some yellow are green.

II. All white are green.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some green are yellow.

II. Some green are white.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
**Given** Statements:

I. Some yellow are green.

II. All white are green.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac0113fa963e21c2811d1506205b7813dddb43777023fa4718fe2a2cdb355020.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some green are yellow. - **True **(Because, Some yellow are green, so Some green are also yellow)

II. Some green are white. - **True **(Because, All white are green, so Some green are also white)

So, Both conclusions I and II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follows**".
